Game Overview

At its heart, Zombie Buster is a adventure game about survive the zombie apocalypse from a unique side-view perspective in Zombie Buster. Armed with powerful weapons, protect your terrace from relentless undead waves. Utilize strategic crowd control, target high-threat bosses, and leverage power-ups to stay alive in increasingly challenging battles.
